verification.notes: Public MIT source and the Windows package manifest were checked at this revision; x64 and ARM64 are supported. The app requires a user-supplied Google Places API key and optionally an Azure Maps key for its live data features. The app icon was downloaded from Assets/Square150x150Logo.png, parsed as a raster PNG, and checked against the MIT-covered source assets. No screenshot or remix claim is included. Stable v1.1.1 App Installer https://github.com/Tray-Land/quick-places/releases/latest/download/QuickPlaces.appinstaller, its immutable same-repository bundle and dependency assets, signed bundle and inner package identities, publisher, and x64/ARM64 packages were independently verified. Remix remains unavailable.
